evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated considerable potential in biomedical applications, while agentic memory systems have emerged as a promising approach to preserving and utilizing information across tasks and interactions.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: We evaluate five memory approaches across four LLMs in three representative settings: biomedical knowledge reasoning, clinical prediction, and long-term conversational memory.

evidence.label: 讨论泛化、污染、稳健性或人工核验
evidence.excerpt: In this study, we systematically investigate agentic memory in the biomedical domain, focusing on task effectiveness, retrieval quality, information fidelity, and long-term robustness.
